closing.summary: Big strengths are protein, usually affordable and scalable, and useful staple energy source, but the biggest weaknesses are low vitamin E, low calcium, and low omega 3. It is good for energy and endurance sports, heart health, and practical meals because the carb section gives usable fuel, fibre supports the heart-health side, and the food-type role makes it easy to build meals around.
